title: Citius Pharmaceuticals and Citius Oncology to Participate in Upcoming October 2025 Conferences
summary: Citius Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq: CTXR) and Citius Oncology, Inc. (Nasdaq: CTOR) today announced that management will be participating in three investor conferences in October 2025. Citius Pharmaceuticals (Nasdaq: CTXR) Event: LD Micro Main Event XIX Date: October 19-21, 2025 Location: Hotel Del Coronado, San Diego, California Event website: Conference registration Event: Think Equity Conference Date: October 30, 2025 Location: Mandarin Oriental, New York Event website: Conference registration Interested parties may schedule 1-on-1 meetings with Citius management by registering through the event platform or contacting the Company's investor relations team.
